title: DetectionFindingV1
description: Canonical schema for Dependency Guardian detection findings produced by algorithmic, AI, or hybrid engines.

id.description: Unique identifier for this specific finding occurrence.

rule_id.description: Stable rule identifier corresponding to the detection rule triggered.

fingerprint.description: Stable deterministic hash or string used to deduplicate repeated detections of the same structural change across runs.

severity.description: Risk or impact severity level. Orthogonal to compatibility classification.

method.description: Affected HTTP method (e.g. GET, POST, DELETE), or null if path-level.

schema_location.description: JSON pointer or path within the OpenAPI document locating the difference.

previous_value.description: Value present in the baseline specification, if applicable.

current_value.description: Value observed in the current specification, if applicable.

message.description: Human-readable evidence-based explanation of the finding.

evidence.description: Structured evidence dictionary capturing baseline vs current diff, snippet, or properties.

confidence.description: Confidence score between 0.0 and 1.0 (1.0 for deterministic findings).

source.description: Origin engine or mode that produced or finalized this finding.

review_required.description: Indicates if manual human review is advised (e.g. for ambiguous or potentially breaking changes).

ai_reasoning.description: Contextual reasoning, impact analysis, or remediation advice generated by AI.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the finding was generated.
